name: sisdoc-modernizado
description: SISDOC Modernizado — scripts raíz para levantar el sistema completo

scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c bgBlue.white,bgGreen.black --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
